fusions.name: Pinning Stamp
fusions.desc: Stamps on the target's foot, dealing 12 damage, stunning it for 1 second and leaving it [Pinned] for 2 seconds and [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Closing Circle
fusions.desc: Paces a tight ring around you, dealing 28 damage to every enemy within 4 tiles, ignoring their resistances, and leaving each [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Barred Path
fusions.desc: Raises a line of bars 5 tiles long for 6 seconds that nothing can cross. You move 20% faster for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Restless Pacing
fusions.desc: Each time you cover a long stretch of ground, a shield worth 12% of your maximum health closes over you for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
